items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small pill that labels a status, a count or a category next to other content, such as paid, pending or overdue. Choose it for short read-only labels, and use the dot, image, count and remove parts to add detail; it comes in three shapes, three sizes and six variants.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button with ten variants, five sizes, five icon-only sizes and a loading state that keeps its width.
